name: es-kairos
description: Native AppKit MCP server for macOS Calendar, Reminders, and Contacts via EventKit. Calendar: calendar_list, events_in_range, event_search, event_create, event_update, event_delete. Reminders: reminder_lists, reminders_today, reminders_in_range, reminder_search, reminder_create, reminder_update, reminder_complete, reminder_delete. Contacts: contact_search. Interactive prompts: ask_user. Shows a confirmation dialog before deletion.
